name: wolf-erp-desktop
description: Wolf ERP for Windows — a standalone Tauri shell around the Wolf ERP client, connected to the same backend as the website.

scripts.export: npm run sync && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.build:exe: npm run export && node scripts/build.js -- --bundles nsis
scripts.build:msi: npm run export && node scripts/build.js -- --bundles msi
scripts.build:all: npm run export && node scripts/build.js -- --bundles nsis,msi
